verdict.rationale: Twilio's own Voice product documents unattended, event-driven call handling: it can respond to calls, gather input, record and take payments without a person answering. A community note confirms TwiML bins and Functions run on Twilio without external hosting. This is narrow, channel-specific automation built from developer primitives, not a general autonomous background automation feature. missing for 10: a documented general automation/workflow builder, recurring or scheduled background runs, agentic autonomous task execution, and independent hands-on corroboration of unattended automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: respond to incoming phone calls, gather user input, record calls, and take payments without needing a person to answer the phone
the easiest way to use Twilio without external hosting
